name: George Fraser
role: Refrigerator Car Co. cowboy killed by lightning, 1886
bio: George Fraser rode for the Refrigerator Car Co. and went to the Hashknife camp with Riley Brooks in May 1886. He was killed by lightning in late August 1886, and the Cow Boy condemned the Bismarck Tribune for falsely reporting that the sheriff had killed two cowboys.
mentions: George Frazer and Riley Brooks left this morning for the Hashknife camp, where they will represent the Ref. Car Co. in the round-up which starts from there about the 17th.

Riley Brooks who came in to announce the death of George Fraser yesterday morning, rode about eighteen miles in fifty-five minutes. The hope of doing something to aid his dead comrade lent wings to the errand of mercy.
